items.name: Ledger copy
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Compare this supplied copy with a consenting clerk's entry.
items.effect: Preserves a recorded quantity for comparison; authenticity and missing context remain questions.
items.limits: One employer copy; contains no police or Coast Guard access permit.
items.upkeep: Keep provenance notes; loss leaves the original clerk as an alternative.
items.substitute: Ask the clerk to explain the entry in front of a witness.

items.name: Inspection request card
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Present a fictional employer's request for a supervised look at an idle crate.
items.effect: Identifies the request; the owner may refuse or offer a public viewing.
items.limits: One signed request, not a warrant, badge or universal dock pass.
items.upkeep: Record who grants permission; if refused, use the public-facing label or a witness.
items.substitute: View an exposed delivery label from the public side.

items.name: Receipt notebook
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Write down a voluntary account and let the speaker check the wording.
items.effect: Separates observed quantities from allegations; no persuasion bonus or binding legal effect.
items.limits: Three blank statement leaves are a scenario allocation.
items.upkeep: One leaf per account; if exhausted use an oral statement witnessed by both characters.
items.substitute: Conduct a witnessed oral interview without a written statement.

scenes.title: Freight office
scenes.entry: A damp ledger carries two different totals. Reach it through the preceding lead; the first scene is the agreed starting appointment.
scenes.exit_condition: Follow the next lead or leave with an explicitly incomplete report at the final scene.
scenes.npc: Clerk Neri wants the worker treated fairly but fears losing employment; she shares a selected entry.
scenes.clue: The discrepancy belongs to a quayside transfer, not the entire ship's cargo.
scenes.pressure: Original shared delay counter starts at 0. Each failed specialist attempt or ordinary route adds 1; at the first total of 3 the primary NPC leaves. The named ordinary-route contact stays available. Further delays do not remove that contact. No automatic HP/SAN loss.

routes.method: Compare the two entries and their recorded units.
routes.cost: One investigative attempt; on failure add one delay and use a different route or meet native-system retry conditions.
routes.outcome: Success: The discrepancy belongs to a quayside transfer, not the entire ship's cargo. Failure: Failure leaves the amount uncertain; Neri identifies the relevant quay and the limit of her knowledge.

routes.method: Negotiate the specific cooperation described in the NPC entry.
routes.cost: An interview and an offered favor; decline or failed persuasion leaves the ordinary route available.
routes.outcome: Success gains a more precise account with permission; failure withholds that cooperation, not every onward lead.

routes.method: Dispatch runner Jo orally repeats the selected quay from the public delivery board. Jo remains assigned after Neri leaves; the exact disputed quantity remains unconfirmed.
routes.cost: One delay; no special equipment or successful skill roll. Accept less precise evidence and the stated access limits.
routes.outcome: After a failed specialized attempt, take this separate limited lead and pay the ordinary delay. Dispatch runner Jo orally repeats the selected quay from the public delivery board. Jo remains assigned after Neri leaves; the exact disputed quantity remains unconfirmed.

scenes.title: Public quay
scenes.entry: An exposed crate label flaps behind a railing. Reach it through the preceding lead; the first scene is the agreed starting appointment.
scenes.exit_condition: Follow the next lead or leave with an explicitly incomplete report at the final scene.
scenes.npc: Porter Ellis wants no trespass; he offers a public view and names a witness in return for accurate attribution.
scenes.objects: Visible label, request card, porter's shift note.
scenes.clue: A receipt was carried to a nearby lodging house before the cargo complaint.
scenes.pressure: Original shared delay counter starts at 0. Each failed specialist attempt or ordinary route adds 1; at the first total of 3 the primary NPC leaves. The named ordinary-route contact stays available. Further delays do not remove that contact. No automatic HP/SAN loss.

routes.method: Inspect the permitted crate exterior and visible label.
routes.cost: One investigative attempt; on failure add one delay and use a different route or meet native-system retry conditions.
routes.outcome: Success: A receipt was carried to a nearby lodging house before the cargo complaint. Failure: Failure or refused access prevents close inspection; Ellis supplies a slower witness route without confirming the hidden crate contents.

routes.method: Negotiate the specific cooperation described in the NPC entry.

routes.outcome: Success gains a more precise account with permission; failure withholds that cooperation, not every onward lead.

scenes.title: Lodging-house interview
scenes.purpose: Choose what to report and how to protect a source.
scenes.entry: A tired witness asks that names stay off the public notice. Reach it through the preceding lead; the first scene is the agreed starting appointment.
scenes.exit_condition: Follow the next lead or leave with an explicitly incomplete report at the final scene.
scenes.npc: Witness Ro fears retaliation; they agree to describe the handover if identity stays private.
scenes.objects: Receipt notebook, voluntary account, returned stub.
scenes.clue: The handover account contradicts the accusation but leaves the final cargo recipient unresolved.
scenes.pressure: Original shared delay counter starts at 0. Each failed specialist attempt or ordinary route adds 1; at the first total of 3 the primary NPC leaves. The named ordinary-route contact stays available. Further delays do not remove that contact. No automatic HP/SAN loss.
